shots.scene: 欣欣站在电脑和空白白板前，白板上画着一条上升的曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard showing a simple rising curve pictogram, next to a laptop with a blank screen, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲合成生物学的建模。

shots.scene: 电脑、DNA双螺旋和荧光孔板三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a laptop with a curve on its screen, a DNA double helix, and a glowing green microplate. No people.
shots.narration: 从设计循环，到方程和校准测量。

shots.scene: 阿杰兴奋地抱着一盒空白标签的质粒管走向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student excitedly carries a rack of small tubes with blank labels toward a lab bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰的团队想做一个会发光的基因电路。

shots.scene: 一堆反复失败的实验图标：培养板、问号、循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Floating icons of culture plates, a question mark and a looping arrow repeating over and over. No people.
shots.narration: 他打算直接动手，不行就再试。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指着笔记本电脑上的空白曲线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently stops the young male student and points to a laptop screen showing a blank chart with a curve.
shots.narration: 小研说：先在电脑里把电路算一算。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，看着小研的电脑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking at the laptop screen of the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 建模，要放在进实验室之前。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头示意
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods encouragingly.
shots.narration: 我们一步一步来。

shots.section_title: 先建模设计，再进实验室
shots.scene: 欣欣指着一条从电脑指向实验室大门的箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large arrow that goes from a laptop icon to a laboratory door icon.
shots.narration: 先建模、先设计，再进实验室。
overlay: 先建模设计，再进实验室

shots.section_title: 先建模设计，再进实验室
shots.scene: 实验室门上挂着暂停图标，学生在家对着电脑学习
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with a pause icon; beside it the female graduate student studies equations on a laptop at a home desk.
shots.narration: 进不了实验室的日子，正好学建模。

shots.section_title: 先建模设计，再进实验室
shots.scene: 两块空白卡片：一个灯泡、一个起跑线
shots.prompt_en: Two blank cards side by side: one with a light bulb icon, one with a starting line icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要明白为什么建模，也要知道怎么开始。

shots.scene: 建筑模型和真正的楼房并排
shots.prompt_en: A small wooden architectural model of a building sits beside a full-size real building in the background. No people.
shots.narration: 建筑师开工前，先做一个楼房模型。

shots.scene: 小鱼在鱼缸里游，旁边是人体轮廓图标
shots.prompt_en: A small striped fish swims in a glass tank; beside it a simple human silhouette icon linked by a dotted arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 生物学家用小鱼当模式生物研究别的生物。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手比出一个框，框里是缩小的系统图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot makes a frame with both paws; inside the frame floats a miniature gear system icon.
shots.narration: 模型，就是代表另一个系统的东西。

shots.section_title: 三类模型：示意图、反应式、方程
shots.scene: 白板上画着几个圆圈和连线的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A blank whiteboard with a simple schematic of circles connected by arrows, like a small circuit diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类是示意图，画出元件怎么相互作用。
overlay: 三类模型：示意图、反应式、方程

shots.section_title: 三类模型：示意图、反应式、方程
shots.scene: 白板上出现几行箭头连接的反应式图标
shots.prompt_en: The same whiteboard now shows several lines of reaction arrows between colored dots, without any letters. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类是生化反应式，讲各物质怎么转化。

shots.section_title: 三类模型：示意图、反应式、方程
shots.scene: 反应式变成一组随时间变化的曲线
shots.prompt_en: The reaction arrows transform into a chart of several smooth curves changing over time. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类是常微分方程，算出数量随时间变化。

shots.section_title: 三类模型：示意图、反应式、方程
shots.scene: 欣欣指着从反应式到曲线的转换箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a conversion arrow from the reaction icons to the curve chart.
shots.narration: 用质量作用定律，就能把反应式写成方程。

shots.scene: 阿杰面前堆满实验数据图，旁边一个硬套的曲线被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits behind a pile of blank data charts; a floating icon of a curve forced through scattered points is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 先做一堆实验再拿模型硬凑，不可取。

shots.scene: 一座桥塌了又重建的循环图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bridge collapsing and being rebuilt again and again in a loop, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 就像造桥，塌了再造，太浪费。

shots.scene: 三段圆环循环图：电脑、DNA、显微镜
shots.prompt_en: A circular cycle diagram with three nodes: a laptop icon, a DNA helix icon and a microscope icon, connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 工程做法是一个循环：设计、构建、测试。

shots.scene: 电脑节点高亮，小研在电脑上画曲线
shots.prompt_en: The laptop node of the cycle glows; the female graduate student draws a curve on a laptop.
shots.narration: 设计阶段先建模和模拟。

shots.scene: DNA节点高亮，阿杰在实验台前组装质粒
shots.prompt_en: The DNA node glows; the young male student in a lab coat, gloves and safety glasses works at a tidy lab bench with small tubes.
shots.narration: 构建阶段组装、克隆，测试阶段校准测量。

shots.scene: 循环箭头从测试回到设计
shots.prompt_en: A bold arrow goes from the microscope node back to the laptop node of the cycle. No people.
shots.narration: 结果不理想，就回到再设计。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块勾选清单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank checklist board with four check marks.
shots.narration: 建模能证明设计可行，指导挑选元件。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上预测曲线，旁边实验室门还关着
shots.prompt_en: A laptop screen shows a predicted curve while a lab door beside it is still closed. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先预测电路的输出。

shots.scene: 一个旋钮被微调，整体曲线随之变化
shots.prompt_en: A small dial is turned slightly and a large curve chart beside it shifts in response. No people.
shots.narration: 改动一个元件，看整体性能怎么变。

shots.scene: 几个变量图标中一个被放大镜标出
shots.prompt_en: Several variable icons in a row; a magnifying glass highlights one of them. No people.
shots.narration: 找出影响最大的那个变量。

shots.scene: 电脑里模拟多种方案，只挑一个去实验
shots.prompt_en: On a laptop screen several design options appear as small cards; one card is checked and carried toward a lab bench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先在模型里排障，再挑最好的方案去做。

shots.scene: 钱袋和时钟图标，旁边有向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a money bag and a clock, each with a downward arrow indicating savings. No people.
shots.narration: 省时间、省经费，也降低决策风险。

shots.scene: 电脑里模拟出危险和昂贵的条件图标
shots.prompt_en: A laptop shows a simulated warning icon and a money bag icon inside its screen. No people.
shots.narration: 危险或昂贵的条件，先在模型里试。

shots.section_title: 中心法则与转录单元四元件
shots.scene: DNA螺旋经箭头变成mRNA链，再变成蛋白质小球
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix, an arrow to a single strand, another arrow to a chain of colored beads folding into a protein blob. No people.
shots.narration: 建模的对象是中心法则。
overlay: 中心法则与转录单元四元件

shots.section_title: 中心法则与转录单元四元件
shots.scene: RNA聚合酶小机器沿DNA移动，核糖体沿mRNA移动
shots.prompt_en: A small cartoon enzyme slides along DNA making a strand; a ribosome slides along the strand making a bead chain. No people.
shots.narration: DNA转录成mRNA，再翻译成蛋白质。

shots.section_title: 中心法则与转录单元四元件
shots.scene: 一条DNA上排列四个彩色元件符号
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal DNA line with four colored part symbols in order: a bent arrow, a half circle, a wide arrow, and a T shape. No people.
shots.narration: 一个转录单元有四种基本元件。

shots.section_title: 中心法则与转录单元四元件
shots.scene: 启动子和RBS符号被调节旋钮图标标出
shots.prompt_en: The bent arrow and the half circle symbols are highlighted with small control dial icons. No people.
shots.narration: 启动子管转录，RBS管翻译起始。

shots.section_title: 中心法则与转录单元四元件
shots.scene: 编码序列和终止子符号高亮
shots.prompt_en: The wide arrow and the T symbol are highlighted; a protein icon floats above the wide arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 编码序列决定产物，终止子结束转录。

shots.section_title: 中心法则与转录单元四元件
shots.scene: 四层积木由小到大叠起
shots.prompt_en: Four stacked blocks of increasing size, from small parts at the bottom to a whole system at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 元件组成转录单元，再组成器件和系统。

shots.section_title: 组成型表达与受调控表达
shots.scene: 一个一直亮着的灯泡开关图标
shots.prompt_en: A light switch icon locked in the on position with a bulb always glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 组成型表达：基因一直开着。
overlay: 组成型表达与受调控表达

shots.section_title: 组成型表达与受调控表达
shots.scene: 一个可开可关的开关，旁边有蛋白小手
shots.prompt_en: A light switch toggling between off and on, with a small protein icon pressing it. No people.
shots.narration: 受调控表达：由转录因子决定开或关。

shots.section_title: 组成型表达与受调控表达
shots.scene: 转录因子结合在启动子上，一边是加号一边是减号
shots.prompt_en: A transcription factor protein icon sits on the bent arrow symbol; a green plus sign on one side and a red minus sign on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 转录因子可以激活，也可以抑制。

shots.section_title: 组成型表达的方程模型
shots.scene: 小研在白板前画两个箱子：mRNA箱和蛋白箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws two boxes on a blank whiteboard connected by an arrow, with inflow and outflow arrows.
shots.narration: 先给最简单的组成型表达写方程。
overlay: 组成型表达的方程模型

shots.section_title: 组成型表达的方程模型
shots.scene: 水龙头向第一个箱子注水，底部漏水
shots.prompt_en: A faucet pours water into the first tank while a small drain at its bottom lets water out. No people.
shots.narration: mRNA以转录速率生成，按比例降解。

shots.section_title: 组成型表达的方程模型
shots.scene: 第一个箱子的水推动第二个箱子注水，第二个箱子也漏水
shots.prompt_en: The first tank feeds a second tank through a pipe; the second tank also has a drain at its bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 蛋白生成取决于翻译速率和mRNA量。

shots.section_title: 组成型表达的方程模型
shots.scene: 加号箭头向上、减号箭头向下
shots.prompt_en: A green plus arrow pointing up and a red minus arrow pointing down beside a tank level gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 方程里正项让数量增加，负项让它减少。

shots.section_title: 组成型表达的方程模型
shots.scene: 箱子水位升高后稳定在一条线
shots.prompt_en: The water level in the second tank rises and then holds steady at a dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 生成和降解平衡时，数量就稳定了。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着方程里的空格发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a blank whiteboard with empty boxes where numbers should go.
shots.narration: 方程写好了，参数从哪儿来？

shots.scene: 小研在电脑上查一个空白的数据表格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student browses a blank data table on a laptop screen, with a book stack icon beside it.
shots.narration: 可以查汇集文献数值的生物学数据库。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁写着时间标签
shots.prompt_en: Two hourglass icons side by side, one small and one large. No people.
shots.narration: 比如大肠杆菌里mRNA半衰期只有几分钟。

shots.scene: 绿色荧光蛋白桶状图标旁一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A green barrel-shaped protein icon next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 绿色荧光蛋白，半衰期约九十分钟。

shots.scene: 三条DNA，只有RBS符号大小不同
shots.prompt_en: Three identical DNA lines, each with the same bent arrow but a half circle symbol of small, medium and large size. No people.
shots.narration: 同一启动子，换上强弱不同的RBS。

shots.scene: 三条水平线高低不同，散点落在线上
shots.prompt_en: A chart with three horizontal lines at low, middle and high levels, with dots lying along each line. No people.
shots.narration: 模型里就是改k2，表达水平跟着变。

shots.scene: 模拟曲线和实验点重合，欣欣点赞
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to a chart where simulated lines match measured dots.
shots.narration: 模拟和实验对得上，模型就靠谱一些。

shots.scene: 激活子蛋白结合启动子，灯泡逐渐变亮
shots.prompt_en: An activator protein icon binds the bent arrow symbol and a light bulb next to it brightens step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 激活子越多，转录越强。

shots.scene: 一条S形上升曲线
shots.prompt_en: A smooth S-shaped rising curve on a blank chart, starting low and leveling off at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 这种S形关系用希尔函数来描述。

shots.scene: 曲线起点有一段抬高的基线
shots.prompt_en: The S-shaped curve with its starting baseline slightly raised above zero, highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 没有激活子时的表达，叫基础表达。

shots.scene: 曲线中点被标出，横轴对应一个点
shots.prompt_en: The midpoint of the S curve is marked with a dot and a dashed line dropping to the horizontal axis. No people.
shots.narration: 输出到一半时的激活子量，是半浓度常数。

shots.scene: 曲线越变越陡，四个小蛋白手拉手
shots.prompt_en: The S curve becomes steeper; beside it four small activator protein icons hold hands together. No people.
shots.narration: 希尔系数越大，开关越陡，协同越强。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑上拖动滑块，曲线变化
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drags slider controls on a blank interactive chart app and the curve shape changes.
shots.narration: 自然界里希尔系数多在一到四之间。

shots.scene: 阻遏子蛋白挡在启动子上，灯泡变暗
shots.prompt_en: A repressor protein icon blocks the bent arrow symbol and a light bulb next to it dims. No people.
shots.narration: 阻遏子越多，表达越低。

shots.scene: 一条S形下降曲线
shots.prompt_en: A smooth S-shaped falling curve on a blank chart, starting high and dropping to a low plateau. No people.
shots.narration: 曲线和激活子正好反过来。

shots.scene: 下降曲线的底部没有落到零
shots.prompt_en: The falling curve's bottom plateau stays above zero, the gap highlighted with a small bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 压到最低还剩一点，叫泄漏表达。

shots.scene: 理想开关和漏水开关对比
shots.prompt_en: Two faucets side by side: one fully closed and dry, one closed but still dripping. No people.
shots.narration: 理想启动子不漏，实际启动子多少会漏。

shots.section_title: 准稳态近似：把模型变简单
shots.scene: 快跑的兔子和慢走的乌龟
shots.prompt_en: A fast rabbit icon labeled by a quick arrow and a slow turtle icon labeled by a short arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 转录这类反应很快，很快就到平衡。
overlay: 准稳态近似：把模型变简单

shots.section_title: 准稳态近似：把模型变简单
shots.scene: 第一个箱子水位锁定，变化率标为零
shots.prompt_en: The first water tank's level is locked with a padlock icon, its change arrow shown as flat. No people.
shots.narration: 可以让mRNA的变化率近似为零。

shots.section_title: 准稳态近似：把模型变简单
shots.scene: 两个方程合并成一个
shots.prompt_en: Two stacked equation cards merge into a single card with a merging arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 解出mRNA代入蛋白方程，只剩一个方程。

shots.section_title: 准稳态近似：把模型变简单
shots.scene: 电脑上画出几条高低不同的上升曲线
shots.prompt_en: A laptop screen plots several rising curves that level off at different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 用软件数值求解，激活子越多稳态越高。

shots.section_title: 让模型和实验数据对上
shots.scene: 小研把孔板放进读板仪
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat places a microplate into a benchtop plate reader with a blank display.
shots.narration: 固定激活子浓度，定时测荧光。
overlay: 让模型和实验数据对上

shots.section_title: 让模型和实验数据对上
shots.scene: 时钟图标旁，数据点沿上升曲线排开
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon beside a chart where data dots line up along a rising curve that levels off. No people.
shots.narration: 比如每5分钟测一次，和方程的解比较。

shots.section_title: 让模型和实验数据对上
shots.scene: 多个孔板浓度递增，得到S形散点
shots.prompt_en: A row of wells with increasing color intensity, and a chart of dots forming an S-shaped curve. No people.
shots.narration: 等到稳态，再测不同激活子浓度。

shots.section_title: 让模型和实验数据对上
shots.scene: S形曲线穿过散点，旁边参数卡片打勾
shots.prompt_en: A smooth S curve passes through the dots; beside it blank parameter cards get check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 用剂量响应曲线，就能估出模型参数。

shots.section_title: 复杂电路的建模与化简
shots.scene: 细胞图标里信号分子进出，形成回路箭头
shots.prompt_en: A cell outline with small signal molecule dots moving in and out, and a looping arrow inside forming a feedback circle. No people.
shots.narration: 再看一个群体感应的负反馈电路。
overlay: 复杂电路的建模与化简

shots.section_title: 复杂电路的建模与化简
shots.scene: 信号分子越多，回路上的减号越亮
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cell icon the signal dots pile up and a red minus sign on the loop glows brighter. No people.
shots.narration: 产物越多，反过来压低自己的表达。

shots.section_title: 复杂电路的建模与化简
shots.scene: 一大摞方程卡片
shots.prompt_en: A tall stack of blank equation cards next to a cell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 二十多个反应，写出一大组方程。

shots.section_title: 复杂电路的建模与化简
shots.scene: 大摞卡片经快反应假设变成薄薄几张
shots.prompt_en: The tall stack of cards passes through a funnel and comes out as a thin stack. No people.
shots.narration: 用准稳态近似，化简成降阶模型。

shots.section_title: 复杂电路的建模与化简
shots.scene: 两条曲线开头不同，最后汇合到同一水平
shots.prompt_en: Two curves, one solid and one dotted, differ at the start but converge to the same level. No people.
shots.narration: 动态略有差别，稳态结果一致。

shots.section_title: 复杂电路的建模与化简
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指提醒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger as a gentle reminder.
shots.narration: 可以简化，但要清楚丢掉了什么。

shots.scene: 培养皿和试管里发出绿色荧光
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish and a closed tube glowing soft green on a dark background. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光是观察细胞内部的好办法。

shots.scene: 水母图标和绿色荧光蛋白桶状结构
shots.prompt_en: A jellyfish icon and a green barrel-shaped protein structure icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 绿色荧光蛋白来自水母，是好的报告蛋白。

shots.scene: 一排不同颜色的荧光管
shots.prompt_en: A row of closed tubes glowing in different colors from blue to red. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光蛋白种类很多，颜色各不相同。

shots.scene: 两组重叠程度不同的光谱曲线
shots.prompt_en: Two sets of colored peak curves, one heavily overlapping and one well separated. No people.
shots.narration: 按激发和发射光谱，挑合适的组合。

shots.scene: 读板仪读出荧光，旁边一瓶标准品
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop plate reader with a blank display beside a small bottle of standard dye with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 用荧光标准品，把读数换算成分子数。

shots.scene: 微球颗粒和浊度计图标
shots.prompt_en: Tiny uniform beads in a tube next to an optical density meter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用微球颗粒校准光密度，换算细胞数。

shots.scene: 荧光曲线除以细胞数曲线，得到一个细胞图标
shots.prompt_en: A fluorescence curve divided by a cell count curve, with an arrow pointing to a single cell icon containing protein dots. No people.
shots.narration: 两者一除，就是每个细胞的分子数。

shots.scene: 细胞图标与方程里的蛋白变量相连
shots.prompt_en: The single cell icon is linked by a dashed line to a blank equation card on a laptop. No people.
shots.narration: 这正对应模型里的蛋白数量。

shots.scene: 循环图中测试箭头回到设计
shots.prompt_en: The three-node cycle diagram with the arrow from the microscope node back to the laptop node glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 校准测量把结果带回设计，完成循环。

shots.section_title: 机理模型与数据驱动模型
shots.scene: 一个黑箱子：数据进，预测出
shots.prompt_en: A black box with a stream of data dots going in on one side and a prediction arrow coming out the other. No people.
shots.narration: 机器学习模型像黑箱，要大量数据。
overlay: 机理模型与数据驱动模型

shots.section_title: 机理模型与数据驱动模型
shots.scene: 透明箱子里能看到齿轮
shots.prompt_en: A transparent box with visible gears and a small DNA icon inside. No people.
shots.narration: 机理模型从原理出发，能解释发生了什么。

shots.section_title: 机理模型与数据驱动模型
shots.scene: 欣欣站在两个箱子之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between the black box and the transparent box, gesturing to both.
shots.narration: 两种方法各有用处，看手里的数据。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现示意图、反应式、曲线三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three floating icons: a schematic, reaction arrows and a curve chart.
shots.narration: 模型有三类，先设计、再构建、后测试。

shots.scene: 启动子、RBS和S形曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bent arrow, a half circle and an S-shaped curve in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 元件定参数，希尔函数描述调控。

shots.scene: 大摞卡片变薄，曲线穿过散点
shots.prompt_en: A thick stack of cards becoming thin, and a curve passing through measured dots. No people.
shots.narration: 合理化简，用校准数据检验模型。

shots.scene: 荧光管、标准品瓶和循环箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glowing green tube, a small standard bottle and a circular arrow in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 选好荧光蛋白，校准后带回设计。

shots.scene: 欣欣在电脑和实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a laptop and a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 先建模，再动手，下次见！
